The retrieved evidence does not contain an explicit explanation of the importance of, or need for, conducting this review. The only Introduction chunk describes global surgical mortality without stating why this review is needed.

No similar prior systematic review is identified or cited in the retrieved evidence, so there is no indication that this review is an update or replication requiring justification against a previous review.

This review addresses prevalence and predictors of an outcome, not a complex intervention or delivery context, so a logic model is not required.
